testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect projects from the template chooser ✔ Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/assembly-template-fixture.opj` as its active project ✔ And the user opens the new-document template chooser ✔ And the user selects the `Standard (mm)` assembly template and displays its details ✔ When the user chooses Projects in the chooser ✔ Then a Projects dialog opens above the chooser ✔ And the fixture project name and location are listed ✔ And the fixture project is marked as active ✔ And the dialog displays a project settings tree ✔ When the user chooses Done without changing the project ✔ Then the Projects dialog closes ✔ And the template chooser is displayed again ✔ And the previously selected template details remain displayed
